reviews.title: Good Concept
reviews.text: If you have a small pool service business, this app can prove itself useful. However, if you plan to incorporate it in your semi-large to large pool company, do not use Skimmer. Very buggy, slow, and frustrating... 2 stars

reviews.title: Trash
reviews.text: More vibe coded BS. So many features, and all are executed poorly. If you have a service department, don’t use this app. Not service technician friendly and a huge headache for everyone else.

reviews.title: Trash

Does Abby trash it was great when I was a mom and pop up big company took over it and now it never works. reviews.title: Update broke saved password autofill
reviews.text:
Great up until latest update! 
The latest update 12.16 removed the ability to recall saved passwords on iPhone. I run my own pool business and also service accounts for another company as a tech, so I switch between two logins several times a day while on the road. Before the update, switching took seconds. Now I have to manually type a username and password every time, which wastes working time and is a real problem when I'm logging service data between stops.

I contacted support, submitted the screen recording they asked for, and followed up by email. No response so far. This is a basic workflow feature for anyone managing more than one account. Please restore autofill support or tell us when a fix is coming.

reviews.title: App often signs you out
reviews.text: App signs you out and inconveniences you and slows you down from getting to your work. This is annoying when you could just leave people’s accounts signed in. I’m busy I don’t have time to reset a password that I haven’t had to in a year just so I can access my work.

reviews.title: Meh, more of a headache
reviews.text: App didn’t even auto update or tell me there was an update. It started performing super slow and updating was taking ten minutes or more even on WiFi at 1gbs. Went to check the store and what a surprise, update

reviews.title: To Many Glitches
reviews.text: Used to be a good app! Not good anymore! We do not get work done efficiently bc of all the glitches and updates that are NOT needed

reviews.title: Great idea, buggy as all get out
reviews.text: When It works it’s great. Most times I need to restart the app to get a customers page to load

reviews.title: Worst app
reviews.text: Constantly freezing, have consistent issues with syncing, I can’t believe we pay for this app and it works like this. I email support, takes weeks to hear back. Do NOT recommend for anyone with more than 25 pools. It’s so bad we are developing our own with our in house team. Trash! Stay away!!!!

reviews.title: No connection to customers
reviews.text:
They will make improvements that you don’t care about and then double your price. At first they’ll make the upgrade an add on but when no one wants to pay extra for it they’ll just raise your price an tell you that add on is included.

They’ve double the price twice in the last few years. 

Don’t get started with them is my advice.

They started out being run by real pool guys but that’s no longer the case and as a customer I feel that.

reviews.title: Always Doubles Jobs!
reviews.text: I use two devices. My cell is marked as my primary device in the app and my tablet is secondary, not marked as primary device. It almost ALWAYS doubles my route stops. It looks so messy and is very frustrating to not be able to tell how many jobs I actually have left and it ruins what order my jobs are in. It said it was fixed recently but it is still happening.

reviews.title: Great idea, poor execution
reviews.text: Overpriced and they still after 4 years haven’t fixed their double route stop issue if you log in under two devices.

reviews.title: Fix the Bugs
reviews.text: If you’re going to charge more for the use of the software you guys can at least fix the old bugs. There is no way syncing from any amount of different devices or anything should cause loss of completion on any stops. The fact that you guys are unable to prevent half of a days completed work from being completely erased is insane. Do better. This is a glitch I and my techs have experienced so many times that I’m sick of it. Do better for your customers

reviews.title: Terrible Update
reviews.text: What is the point of adding a dialogue when finishing work orders when you can just tap to unfinish it anyway? Its annoying. Please revert back.

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: App is mediocre at best.   Customer support is mediocre at best these days.   In my opinion, things are going downhill versus getting better.
